title: Automated Project Portfolio Health Monitoring
business: Project Management Offices (PMO) overseeing diverse cross-functional initiatives.
problem: PMOs often struggle with fragmented visibility across dozens of Smartsheet projects, leading to manual, error-prone status reporting and delayed identification of at-risk milestones.
solution: By integrating the Smartsheet connector with Claude, the PMO can automate the retrieval of sheet summaries and row data. Claude acts as an intelligent layer that parses project timelines, identifies bottlenecks, and synthesizes status reports directly from the source of truth, eliminating the need for manual spreadsheet consolidation.
steps: Authorize the Smartsheet connector within the Claude interface to grant read access to specific workspaces.
Use the get_sheet_summary tool to pull high-level metadata and key performance indicators from active project sheets.
Invoke list_workspaces and browse_folder to locate relevant project sheets across the organization.
Prompt Claude to analyze specific row data using get_columns to identify tasks with overdue dates or blocked statuses.
Generate a natural language summary or a structured report based on the retrieved project data.
outcome: The PMO achieves real-time, conversational access to project health, allowing for faster decision-making and reduced administrative overhead in status reporting.
limitation: The connector relies on the existing structure of Smartsheet columns; if column names are inconsistent or non-descriptive across different sheets, Claude may struggle to map data accurately. Users must verify the accuracy of the data mapping by cross-referencing the retrieved column headers with the source sheet before relying on automated summaries.
